title: Sandy D NDE 6125
content: I am now severely paralyzed in my dominate hand and it's very difficult to write. I found myself in a field in compete darkness. Heartbroken I felt my soul shatter like glass and the shards scattered across the grass. I was in a clearing surrounded by tall grass. Big flat rocks were in the clearing; they were boulders, but mostly they were flush with the ground. I lie down and felt the sharp rocks (and when I woke, there were scratches and bruises). I asked God to take me. I was in such emotional pain. I heard rustling through the grass and knew it was not God coming for me, something else was. I closed my eyes in fear and when I opened them, a huge deer was standing over me. It was so close, I reached up and the deer brought its nose to my hand. At that moment, I watched a movie of my life, every tiny detail. So quickly it passed, but it took forever. I saw everything I had done right, every wrong, how each of those actions affected others and I saw when I should have done things and didn't; those were the worst, I understood. Then just like that, I knew I was forgiven. The deer had moved away and was walking off. I turned my head to see it and it stopped and looked back at me. It was then I noticed that the deer was in front of the most beautiful warm glowing light I had ever seen. I looked back towards the sky and all was blackness. I got up, started walking and came to a road. I knew I had to go back. The moment I placed my foot onto the pavement I knew I was too early. I hit the pavement just a split second before I was supposed to. The shards of my soul had not all returned to me and now they were in one place and I another. I could not return to the field and I was missing parts of me. I awoke in the hospital. Some of my soul has found its way back; others are still on different journeys, searching. My life has gone from bad to worse ever since. Not one single good thing has happened and so very much bad. But I find parts of me now and then and when I do I gain another insight, an understanding of who we are and how we connect because of the journey my shattered soul has taken.

arrival.other_being_detail: A huge deer stood over the experiencer and interacted by bringing its nose to the experiencer's hand.

environment.environment_other_detail: Clearing surrounded by tall grass; big flat rocks/boulders mostly flush with the ground; a road/pavement appeared; initial complete darkness/blackness; later a warm glowing light behind the deer.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Felt compelled to go back; stated they returned 'too early' (hit the pavement a split second before supposed to) and could not return to the field.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Soul described as shattering into shards scattered across grass; later described as returning incompletely ('missing parts of me').
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE or tunnel described. Experience begins in darkness/field, then encounter with deer, then life review, then light behind deer, then road/pavement boundary and return to hospital.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experiencer reports their soul shattering like glass into shards scattered across the grass; later states they returned 'too early' and not all soul shards returned, with some 'still on different journeys.' Encounter with a deer as the central figure preceding the life review and light.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I found myself in a field in compete darkness.” “I felt my soul shatter like glass and the shards scattered across the grass.” “At that moment, I watched a movie of my life, every tiny detail.” “I knew I had to go back.” “I hit the pavement just a split second before I was supposed to.”
